description: MMS gate: run the inline esm-spec 6.6 tests of problems/heat_2d_neumann_flux.esm (model Heat2D, test mms_neumann_flux_2d_decay) at the problem's default resolution (NX=NY=64) through each binding's official simulation pathway. Exercises the 2-D Laplacian assembled from the parameterized per-axis Neumann rules central_D2x_neumann_bc + central_D2y_neumann_bc with constant nonzero wall fluxes qXL=qXR=1, qYL=qYR=0.5. The assertions and their tolerances live in the problem file itself; this manifest only routes the runners.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
